figures.caption: Figure 6: Flowchart of the iterative procedure for determining the PSD and the empirical boundary correction from a low-current half-cell measurement. The electrode potential re- sulting from the MPM is compared with the measured electrode potential, and the parameter vector is iteratively updated by a surrogate-based optimization algorithm until the RMSE change threshold is satisfied.
